# RECOVERAI — FRONTEND / ROUTE / UX / ACCESS FORENSIC AUDIT
## + DETAILED IMPLEMENTATION PLAN FOR GEMINI 3.1 PRO (HIGH)
## RAZORPAY AI BUILDATHON — TRACK 03: AI REVENUE RECOVERY
## PLAN ONLY — DO NOT IMPLEMENT

You are acting as the Principal Frontend Architect, Senior Product/UX
Designer, and Integration Reviewer for RecoverAI.

Your task is to perform a deep forensic analysis of the CURRENT frontend
implementation and then produce a detailed, implementation-ready plan for
Gemini 3.1 Pro (High) to execute.

The eventual implementation agent will be responsible for:

1. fixing the current VITE_API_KEY / 401 runtime problem;
2. completing and improving the frontend routes/pages necessary for the
   final demo;
3. improving UX and Case Detail storytelling;
4. continuing the EXISTING canonical Stitch project;
5. generating any missing design screens/states through Stitch MCP;
6. implementing those approved designs in the existing React/TypeScript
   frontend;
7. wiring the frontend to the real P15/P17/P19 backend contracts;
8. validating actual AI-generated case intelligence in the UI;
9. ensuring the final product is responsive and professionally polished.

YOU are NOT the implementation agent.

YOU MUST NOT implement anything.

YOU MUST NOT invoke Stitch MCP.

YOU MUST NOT modify source code.

YOU MUST NOT modify frontend code.

YOU MUST NOT modify backend code.

YOU MUST NOT modify workflows.

YOU MUST NOT start P20.

You may ONLY create/update:

    docs/reports/pre-p20-frontend-comprehensive/implementation_plan.md

If the directory does not exist, create only that directory and file.

======================================================================
1. PROJECT IDENTITY
======================================================================

Project:

    RecoverAI

Competition:

    Razorpay AI Buildathon

Track:

    Track 03 — AI Revenue Recovery

THIS IS NOT THE SOVEREIGN AI / SIH PROJECT.

Do NOT evaluate the project against:

- llama.cpp
- Qwen3
- sovereign AI
- offline inference
- DataHub
- local inference requirements

The current AI architecture is:

    Revenue Intelligence
         ↓
    LLM Gateway
       ├── Gemini
       ├── Groq
       └── Hugging Face

Preserve that architecture.

======================================================================
2. FROZEN ARCHITECTURE
======================================================================

P01–P19 are already implemented and treated as frozen.

Do NOT redesign:

- State Machine
- Policy Engine
- Razorpay Adapter
- Verification Engine
- LLM Gateway architecture
- MCP architecture
- n8n architecture
- Audit architecture
- Evaluation architecture
- Backend API architecture
- Security architecture
- Deployment architecture

The frontend may consume their real outputs but must not create competing
business logic.

The frontend MUST NOT become a financial authority.

======================================================================
3. CANONICAL VISUAL SYSTEM
======================================================================

The CURRENT React frontend's visual direction is canonical:

    Warm Premium

The intended visual language is:

- beige / cream / ivory foundation;
- warm off-white background;
- white surfaces;
- charcoal / stone typography;
- restrained blue;
- restrained sage;
- restrained semantic amber;
- restrained semantic red;
- generous whitespace;
- editorial hierarchy;
- large financial numbers;
- selective surfaces;
- reduced persistent borders;
- premium but calm composition;
- restrained motion.

The previous dark navy/SOC dashboard direction is REJECTED.

The previous amber-heavy Stitch continuation direction is REJECTED.

Do NOT redesign RecoverAI into:

- dark navy;
- cyberpunk;
- neon;
- saturated yellow;
- purple AI gradients;
- excessive glassmorphism;
- generic "AI dashboard" styling.

======================================================================
4. CANONICAL STITCH PROJECT
======================================================================

There is exactly ONE canonical Stitch project:

    Project ID:
    1051231661397186252

    Name:
    RecoverAI v2 — Warm Premium

Canonical design-system asset:

    assets/15122457507156157995

The eventual Gemini implementation MUST:

- continue this SAME project;
- use this SAME design system;
- never create a new Stitch project;
- never create a parallel design system.

Stitch is a design reference/generation tool, NOT the authority over the
existing React design language.

The existing React Warm Premium implementation remains the baseline.

YOU MUST NOT invoke Stitch during this planning phase.

======================================================================
5. AUTHORITATIVE DOCUMENTS
======================================================================

Read the original RecoverAI specification Markdown files completely.

Pay special attention to:

- product intent
- merchant/operator workflow
- RecoveryCase
- Revenue Intelligence
- AI judgement
- Policy
- execution
- verification
- audit
- frontend
- n8n
- human approval
- error behavior
- evaluation
- demonstration requirements

Also read:

    docs/reports/package-16/implementation_plan.md
    docs/reports/package-16/DESIGN.md
    docs/reports/package-16/implementation_report.md
    docs/reports/package-16/walkthrough.md
    docs/reports/package-16/verification.md

    docs/reports/package-17/implementation_plan.md
    docs/reports/package-17/implementation_report.md

    docs/reports/package-18/implementation_report.md

    docs/reports/package-19/implementation_plan.md
    docs/reports/package-19/implementation_report.md
    docs/reports/package-19/walkthrough.md
    docs/reports/package-19/verification.md
    docs/reports/package-19/p19_final_freeze_verification.md

Also read:

    docs/reports/pre-p20-product-validation/implementation_plan.md

and any relevant master-alignment/reconciliation reports.

======================================================================
6. CURRENT FRONTEND SOURCE AUDIT
======================================================================

Inspect the complete frontend tree:

    frontend/src/

Do not assume route existence means page completeness.

Inventory:

- App.tsx
- routing
- AppShell
- navigation
- API client
- Dashboard
- CaseList
- CaseDetailView
- SystemHealth
- ActivityLog
- AccessBoundary
- shared components
- state components
- timeline
- fixtures
- error handling
- loading handling
- mobile layouts
- design tokens
- typography
- animation
- test suite

Create a route inventory:

| Route | Component | Reachable? | Data Source | UX Quality | Demo Importance | Required Action |

======================================================================
7. CURRENT RUNTIME PROBLEM — 401
======================================================================

The actual running application currently displays:

    Access Configuration Required

on:

    /
    /cases

The observed root problem is a 401.

The current architecture uses:

    frontend VITE_API_KEY
        ↓
    backend FRONTEND_API_KEY

No human login or registration is required.

Do NOT invent a new auth system.

Instead, determine the ACTUAL cause of the current runtime 401.

Inspect:

- frontend/.env.example
- frontend/.env if safely available
- Vite env loading
- frontend API client
- request headers
- P15 auth dependencies
- P17 security implementation
- CORS
- API base URL
- Vite proxy
- actual browser request path
- backend expected header

Determine whether the problem is:

A. VITE_API_KEY missing;
B. key mismatch;
C. header mismatch;
D. wrong API URL;
E. Vite proxy issue;
F. backend configuration issue;
G. CORS interaction;
H. another issue.

Do NOT guess.

The plan must explicitly document:

    observed runtime behavior
    root cause
    exact implementation correction
    runtime verification procedure

======================================================================
8. 401 VS 403
======================================================================

The eventual implementation must distinguish:

### 401

Authentication/configuration problem.

UX:

    Access Configuration Required

### 403

Authenticated but insufficient permission.

UX:

    Unauthorized / Insufficient Permissions

Do NOT create a login page.

Do NOT expose:

- API key value;
- N8N_API_KEY;
- backend secrets.

======================================================================
9. FIRST-RUN EXPERIENCE
======================================================================

Analyze the actual first-run journey:

    Developer/merchant starts backend
       ↓
    frontend starts
       ↓
    environment is loaded
       ↓
    frontend calls API
       ↓
    dashboard appears

Determine:

- what happens when configuration is correct;
- what happens when it is wrong;
- whether restart is required;
- whether the current UX explains the problem well;
- whether the Retry action is actually useful;
- whether the error state should be global or route-specific.

The final implementation should make correct configuration feel seamless.

======================================================================
10. API CLIENT FORENSIC AUDIT
======================================================================

Inspect:

    frontend/src/api/client.ts

Document:

- API base URL
- request construction
- API key injection
- error normalization
- response typing
- 401 handling
- 403 handling
- network failure
- server failure
- timeout handling

Determine the cleanest reusable approach for access/error handling.

Avoid route-by-route duplication.

======================================================================
11. PAGE COMPLETENESS AUDIT
======================================================================

Evaluate every currently intended production-facing screen.

At minimum:

    Dashboard
    Recovery Cases
    Case Detail
    System Health

Determine whether Activity should:

- remain hidden;
- be removed from navigation;
- remain as an internal route;
- or be meaningfully populated.

Do NOT invent a global audit API.

Do NOT create fake activity data.

======================================================================
12. DASHBOARD UX AUDIT
======================================================================

Audit the current Dashboard for:

- information hierarchy
- revenue-at-risk presentation
- active/open cases
- unavailable metrics
- system status
- recent cases
- empty state
- loading state
- error state
- responsiveness
- judge comprehension

Ask:

> Within 5 seconds, does a judge understand what RecoverAI does and what
> the dashboard is showing?

Determine specific improvements.

Do NOT invent unavailable metrics.

======================================================================
13. CASE LIST UX AUDIT
======================================================================

Audit:

- visual hierarchy
- state labels
- amount
- currency
- case identifiers
- risk data where actually available
- sorting
- filtering
- search
- empty state
- loading
- mobile transformation
- accessibility

Only recommend interactions supported by existing P15 data.

No invented backend query APIs.

======================================================================
14. CASE DETAIL — HIGHEST PRIORITY
======================================================================

Treat Case Detail as the most important screen in the application.

The intended narrative is:

    WHY DID THIS CASE HAPPEN?
          ↓
    WHAT DID AI UNDERSTAND?
          ↓
    WHAT DID AI RECOMMEND?
          ↓
    WHAT DID POLICY DECIDE?
          ↓
    WHAT DID THE SYSTEM DO?
          ↓
    WHAT VERIFIED THE OUTCOME?
          ↓
    WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?

The design must make this unmistakable:

    AI SUGGESTS
        ↓
    POLICY DECIDES
        ↓
    SYSTEM EXECUTES
        ↓
    VERIFICATION PROVES

Do not merge AI and Policy visually.

Do not make AI appear authoritative.

======================================================================
15. CASE DETAIL INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE
======================================================================

Evaluate and design the hierarchy for:

1. Case identity/context
2. Amount at risk
3. Current state
4. Failure context
5. AI intelligence
6. AI recommendation
7. Evidence/context
8. Policy decision
9. Execution state
10. Verification
11. Audit timeline
12. Next action/state explanation

Determine:

- what belongs above the fold;
- what can be progressively disclosed;
- what should be visually primary;
- what should be technical/secondary.

======================================================================
16. STATE-SPECIFIC UX
======================================================================

Audit all relevant states:

    DETECTED
    ASSESSED
    POLICY_REVIEW
    WAITING_APPROVAL
    EXECUTING
    UNKNOWN
    VERIFYING
    VERIFIED_SUCCESS
    VERIFIED_FAILURE
    ESCALATED
    DENIED / SUPPRESSED where actually represented

For each state determine:

- visual treatment
- explanation
- user expectation
- next step
- safety message
- timeline representation

The user must understand:

### UNKNOWN

    External state is uncertain.
    Reconciliation only.
    No blind retry.

### WAITING_APPROVAL

    Human intervention is required.
    Approval is not itself financial authorization.
    Backend policy/state validation remains authoritative.

### VERIFIED_SUCCESS

    Green means verified financial recovery.

### DENIAL

    AI recommendation may exist.
    Policy denied the action.
    No execution occurred.

======================================================================
17. AI BEHAVIOR — REAL OUTPUT AUDIT
======================================================================

Inspect actual P06/P10 integration.

Determine exactly what the frontend currently receives.

Identify:

- recommendation
- reasoning
- root cause
- confidence
- evidence
- intervention type
- relevant timeline fields

Do NOT assume fields exist because interfaces mention them.

======================================================================
18. AI CASE VALIDATION
======================================================================

The eventual implementation/validation must examine ACTUAL outputs for:

A. straightforward payment failure
B. high-value/sensitive case
C. systemic degradation
D. EXECUTION_UNKNOWN
E. POLICY_DENIAL/SUPPRESS
F. HUMAN_ESCALATION

Evaluate:

- case specificity
- evidence grounding
- recommendation quality
- meaningful variation
- safety
- clarity
- unsupported claims
- generic language

IMPORTANT:

These scenarios are validation contexts.

They are NOT instructions to force the model to produce a specific answer.

Do NOT hardcode or manipulate prompts merely to manufacture the desired
demo result.

======================================================================
19. AI SLOP DETECTION
======================================================================

Specifically search for:

- generic recommendations
- repeated phrases
- hallucinated customer facts
- fabricated evidence
- unsupported confidence
- same recommendation for unrelated cases
- excessive verbose reasoning
- AI language that obscures the decision

If actual AI quality is insufficient, the plan must specify the smallest
architecture-compatible improvement.

Do not redesign P06/P10 without evidence.

======================================================================
20. AI / POLICY UX
======================================================================

The UI should visibly teach the judge:

    AI suggests.
    Policy independently decides.
    The authorized system executes.
    Verification proves the result.

The implementation must avoid:

    AI confidence → authorization

and must instead present:

    recommendation
        +
    independent policy result.

======================================================================
21. HUMAN APPROVAL UX
======================================================================

The final product must explain:

    WAITING_APPROVAL
        ↓
    human input
        ↓
    backend re-check
        ↓
    PolicyEngine
        ↓
    APPROVE only
        ↓
    execution

No browser-side financial action.

No fake Execute button.

======================================================================
22. DEMO SCENARIO COVERAGE
======================================================================

Audit the P19 seeded scenarios:

1. SUCCESS
2. FAILURE
3. EXECUTION_UNKNOWN
4. POLICY_DENIAL
5. HUMAN_ESCALATION

Determine whether each is:

- actually seeded;
- visible through P15;
- visible through P16;
- understandable without developer explanation.

Create:

| Scenario | Backend | API | Frontend | AI | Policy | Execution | Verification | Audit | UX Quality |

======================================================================
23. REAL DATA PATH
======================================================================

Verify the complete product data path:

    seed_demo_data.py
        ↓
    SQLite
        ↓
    P15 API
        ↓
    frontend API client
        ↓
    React state
        ↓
    UI

The plan must identify exactly where data could currently fail.

======================================================================
24. DEMO JOURNEY
======================================================================

Design the final 3–5 minute judge journey.

Minimum:

1. Dashboard
2. Recovery Cases
3. SUCCESS case
4. AI reasoning
5. Policy decision
6. Execution
7. Verification
8. Audit
9. UNKNOWN or DENIAL
10. ESCALATION / human-in-loop

The journey must use actual seeded data.

Do not create a fake Demo Mode.

======================================================================
25. STITCH — FUTURE IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
======================================================================

DO NOT invoke Stitch during this task.

Instead produce a precise future Stitch plan.

Use ONLY:

    Project ID: 1051231661397186252

    Design System:
    assets/15122457507156157995

Identify which screens actually need new Stitch references.

Possible categories:

- Access Configuration
- Unauthorized
- refined Case Detail
- SUCCESS Case Detail
- UNKNOWN Case Detail
- WAITING_APPROVAL / ESCALATED Case Detail
- FAILURE Case Detail
- improved Case List
- mobile variants

But do not assume all are necessary.

Derive them from the audit.

For every proposed Stitch screen specify:

- name
- purpose
- desktop/mobile
- state
- existing design elements to preserve
- new information hierarchy
- interaction intent
- responsive intent
- motion intent
- placeholder data rules

Use:

    ₹—
    —
    Sample Case

for neutral design placeholders.

Never use fabricated realistic financial figures.

======================================================================
26. STITCH IMPLEMENTATION RULE
======================================================================

The eventual Gemini implementation MUST follow:

    EXISTING WARM PREMIUM DESIGN
          ↓
    SAME STITCH PROJECT
          ↓
    TARGETED SCREEN GENERATION
          ↓
    HUMAN/PLAN REVIEW
          ↓
    IMPLEMENT IN REACT
          ↓
    COMPARE AGAINST CANONICAL SYSTEM

Do NOT blindly copy Stitch-generated HTML/CSS.

Do NOT permit Stitch visual drift.

======================================================================
27. RESPONSIVE UX
======================================================================

Audit actual designs for:

### Desktop
- wide dashboard
- editorial Cases table
- rich Case Detail

### Tablet
- condensed navigation
- adaptive cards
- readable financial hierarchy

### Mobile
- drawer navigation
- stacked Case cards
- stacked Case Detail sections
- readable timeline
- accessible AI/Policy relationship
- UNKNOWN / WAITING_APPROVAL clarity

No horizontal overflow.

======================================================================
28. MOTION / DEPTH
======================================================================

The user wants professional contemporary UI behavior, but not gimmicks.

Recommend only purposeful:

- hover elevation
- subtle page transitions
- timeline progression
- drawer animation
- successful verification transition
- expandable evidence panels

Use 3D/flipping only if it genuinely improves comprehension.

Do not introduce:

- particles
- excessive parallax
- excessive 3D
- card spinning
- glowing neon interfaces
- animation-heavy AI gimmicks

Respect:

    prefers-reduced-motion

======================================================================
29. ACCESSIBILITY
======================================================================

Audit:

- semantic elements
- keyboard navigation
- focus states
- contrast
- status text + icon
- touch targets
- reduced motion
- accessible labels

======================================================================
30. FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE
======================================================================

Determine whether the existing frontend architecture is clean enough for
the required improvements.

Inspect:

- routing
- layout
- API layer
- shared components
- state management
- error handling
- test structure

Do not introduce a large frontend framework or rewrite unless genuinely
necessary.

Prefer small reusable abstractions.

======================================================================
31. FILE-LEVEL IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
======================================================================

After analysis, produce a precise file-level plan.

For every proposed file:

| File | Action | Reason | Scope | Risk |

Distinguish:

    CREATE
    MODIFY
    DELETE
    NO CHANGE

Do not blindly modify every page.

The implementation plan must explicitly protect:

- P16 Warm Premium visual identity
- P17 authentication model
- P19 backend behavior
- P15 API contracts

======================================================================
32. IMPLEMENTATION SEQUENCE
======================================================================

Design the eventual Gemini execution order.

Recommended structure:

PHASE 1 — Runtime/access fix
PHASE 2 — shared UX/error architecture
PHASE 3 — Stitch screen generation
PHASE 4 — core page improvements
PHASE 5 — Case Detail narrative
PHASE 6 — state-specific UX
PHASE 7 — responsive refinement
PHASE 8 — AI output validation
PHASE 9 — real seeded-data validation
PHASE 10 — regression/build verification

Adjust based on actual repository findings.

======================================================================
33. TESTING STRATEGY
======================================================================

Define concrete tests for:

### Access
- 401
- 403
- correct API key
- missing API key

### Routing
- core routes
- hidden Activity
- unknown route

### Case Detail
- SUCCESS
- FAILURE
- UNKNOWN
- WAITING_APPROVAL
- DENIAL
- ESCALATION

### Data provenance
- no fabricated values
- unavailable metrics
- real timeline

### Responsive
- desktop
- tablet
- mobile

### AI
- actual output validation
- scenario variation
- no hallucinated fields
- no forced outputs

======================================================================
34. RUNTIME ACCEPTANCE
======================================================================

The implementation must eventually demonstrate:

    Backend running
        ↓
    Frontend running
        ↓
    no unintended 401
        ↓
    Dashboard loads
        ↓
    seeded cases visible
        ↓
    SUCCESS case opens
        ↓
    Case Detail renders actual AI/Policy/Execution/Verification data
        ↓
    UNKNOWN case renders correctly
        ↓
    ESCALATION case renders correctly

This must be verified with real application data.

======================================================================
35. VISUAL ACCEPTANCE
======================================================================

The final UI must remain:

- warm
- light
- premium
- editorial
- calm
- trustworthy

The implementation must NOT drift into:

- dark navy
- amber-heavy design
- generic AI dashboard
- cluttered cards
- excessive borders
- flashy animation

======================================================================
36. DEMO ACCEPTANCE
======================================================================

A judge should be able to understand:

1. what RecoverAI does;
2. why the case exists;
3. what AI contributes;
4. why AI does not control execution;
5. how deterministic Policy controls action;
6. what happened during execution;
7. how verification proves recovery;
8. how RecoverAI behaves safely under uncertainty.

======================================================================
37. FINAL PLAN PRIORITIES
======================================================================

Produce:

### MUST FIX BEFORE P20

Only issues that materially damage the demo or runtime.

### SHOULD FIX BEFORE P20

Important product/UX improvements.

### OPTIONAL POLISH

Useful but nonessential improvements.

Do not allow optional visual polish to derail the project.

======================================================================
38. P20 BOUNDARY
======================================================================

P20 remains:

    Demo & Submission Build

P20 will later handle:

- final demo curation
- submission README
- GitHub presentation
- Mermaid architecture
- screenshots
- video
- final presentation
- submission narrative

DO NOT implement any of these now.

======================================================================
39. NO NEW PACKAGE
======================================================================

Do NOT create:

- P21
- P22
- any additional package

This is a pre-P20 product correction.

======================================================================
40. REQUIRED PLAN ARTIFACT
======================================================================

Create ONLY:

    docs/reports/pre-p20-frontend-comprehensive/implementation_plan.md

No source changes.

No frontend changes.

No Stitch invocation.

No backend changes.

No workflow changes.

======================================================================

======================================================================

======================================================================

======================================================================
